questions.question: Right after the close-up shots of the rocket engines igniting, what is shown next?
questions.answer: A hazy wide view of an industrial skyline of towers and refineries with a bright glow, captioned that the film is supported by the Netherlands Film Fund.
accept: city of towers with a bright glow
Netherlands Film Fund credit over a skyline

questions.question: What is on screen while a voice says "This is pretty freaky"?
questions.answer: A human brain sitting on a plate, with a man with a mechanical (robotic) eye leaning in and staring at it from behind.
accept: man with a robotic eye looking at a brain
a brain and a cyborg-eyed man

questions.question: The caption "40 YEARS LATER" appears over a dark machine-filled interior. For about how long does it stay on screen?
During the scene with the sniper on the tower balcony, how many separate times does the picture switch to the circular view through his rifle scope (count each unbroken stretch of scope view once)?
Inside the cathedral with the big organ pipes, which way does the grey-haired man travel on the rope, and where does he end up?
questions.answer: Downward: he slides down the rope from the tower and ends up standing on the stone floor, then walks away from the camera.
accept: he climbs/slides down the rope to the floor

questions.question: Right after the grey-haired man grabs the rope and drops out of view, what does the young sniper do?
questions.answer: He picks up a small juice box and drinks from it through a straw, then grimaces.
accept: sips a drink through a straw

questions.question: In the warm room with the lamps and bookshelf, the grey-haired man stands beside a young woman in a camouflage jacket. Which way does he leave the frame?
questions.answer: He walks to the left, crossing in front of the young woman, and leaves out the left side of the frame, leaving her alone in the shot.
accept: walks off left past the woman

questions.question: After a man in a red jacket stands in the square with his arms raised inside a dome of glowing light squares, what is revealed in the square once the light clears?
questions.answer: A giant mechanical robot / huge machine standing in the square by the canal houses.
